challenges: 18-Person Boutique Bandwidth vs. Hollywood-Grade VFX Expectations: Delivering complex CGI, Unreal Engine, motion-capture, and compositing shots every week without burning out generalist artist-hosts who simultaneously appear on camera and render shots.

Fair-Use Copyright Claims & Demonetization on 'VFX Artists React': Navigating automated YouTube Content ID strikes/revenue-claims from major film studios on educational VFX breakdown episodes, making owned CorridorDigital.com SVOD subscriptions existential.

Subscriber Conversion & Churn on Owned CorridorDigital.com Streaming App: Continuously producing exclusive member-only shows (extended React cuts, Son of a Dungeon, crew vlogs) to retain $4/mo ($39.99/yr) subscribers against subscription fatigue.

Integrating Generative AI Video/3D Tools Without Alienating Craft-Purist VFX Community: Balancing technical curiosity in AI rotoscoping, mocap, and neural rendering (*Anime Rock Paper Scissors*) with deep respect for human artistic authorship.
Local Workstation Render & NAS Storage Bottlenecks: Managing multi-terabyte raw RED/Blackmagic footage,EXR caches, and GPU render queues across a small Arts District warehouse studio.
